historical_record.description: A single-family house built in 1936 by Sbarboro, Detjen & Jorgensen, who advertised themselves as the “Pioneer Builders of the Marina District” and had put up a hundred and fifty buildings in it by 1929. No member of the firm was a licensed architect; they designed their own buildings and worked with architects including John Ahnden, Reuben Irvine and Laurence Ebbets.

unknowns: The city's Marina survey dates this house 1936; the citywide collection of professional biographies dates it 1924. Both credit Sbarboro, Detjen & Jorgensen.
